logistics.format: Online multiple-choice (passing score 70/100). Up to 3 attempts.

plus.note: Covers 10 critical risk domains spanning governance, access control and compliance.

minus.note: Lower hiring-manager awareness vs CIPP-E/US, CDPSE.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded governance, access and compliance breadth offers an entry data-protection baseline; zero experience, repeated multiple-choice attempts and limited independent recognition prevent an applied professional inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded ten-domain data-protection breadth offers foundational governance and access-control knowledge. Zero experience, repeated online multiple-choice attempts and limited recognition make this a weak filter for independent privacy delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded ten-domain data-protection breadth offers entry knowledge with no experience requirement. Multiple-choice assessment and limited independent recognition keep it foundational despite the broad certification title.
